messages:
emma: Hey team — dropped a near-final draft of the product post in the doc below. TL;DR: positioning + benchmark narrative + CTA to webinar sign-up. Need copy + legal + demand to weigh in by EOD so we can schedule publish next week. https://docs.google.com/document/d/1A2B3C4D (comments enabled)

jordan: reading now. love the structure. quick ask: can we make the benchmark section less 'lab' and more customer-impact focused? replace raw p50/p95 callouts with a short use case and a single chart.

emma: good call. I can swap the microbenchmarks to a single chart + one liner about cost/latency tradeoff. sam — do you have the chart export?

sam: yep exporting now. attaching PNG in thread: benchmark_vs_baseline.png — it shows 3x token throughput at comparable latency. caption idea: "3x throughput at 99th percentile latency parity"

jordan: caption looks good, but say "throughput per GPU" to be precise. avoid implying lower latency unless we can prove it.

li: demand here — for the CTA we want the blog sign-up to route to HubSpot form `ri_product_launch_v1`. Can we include UTM template and hidden fields so leads map correctly? Example: `?utm_source=blog&utm_campaign=product_post_2026&utm_medium=organic`

emma: added UTM line in the CTA paragraph. li can you paste the exact HS form field names? I remember we need `lead_source`, `campaign_id`, and `interest_area`.

li: HS field names: `lead_source`, `campaign`, `initial_interest`. We'll also need `owner_team` set to `demand-marketing`. Hidden fields snippet we want: ```?utm_source=blog&utm_campaign=product_post_2026&utm_medium=organic&lead_source=blog&campaign=product_post_2026&initial_interest=inference```

emma: perfect, I'll bake that into the CTA link. Also planning a webinar link in the post: https://redwood.com/events/optimize-inference — that should go to the same HS form so we can route registrants.

rachel: legal glance — can you paste the model/benchmark phrasing you're planning to use? Need to check for claims and comparative language. Quick rule: avoid claiming "beats" a vendor without explicit permission.

emma: current draft line: "our runtime delivers 3x throughput per GPU vs. a standard serving baseline while maintaining 99th percentile latency parity." Thoughts?

legal-bot: quick-check results: flags=1; flagged_phrases=["beats","outperforms"]. Suggested safe version: "in our internal benchmarks, the runtime achieved approximately 3x throughput per GPU compared with a representative baseline, with comparable 99th percentile latency." Please add: "Results may vary by workload; see docs for test details."

rachel: legal-bot suggestion LGTM. Add the caveat sentence and link to benchmark methodology doc. Also add a short alt-text for the chart: "Chart: throughput per GPU across baseline and Redwood runtime, higher is better."

emma: updated doc with legal phrasing and methodology link: https://redwood.com/docs/benchmarks. Added alt text and caption changes.

li: one more routing ask — can we add an internal checkbox in the HS form mapping to mark high-value accounts if company size > 500? We use that to auto-trigger sales follow-up. If the form has `company_size` we can map: `company_size: >500 -> lifecycle_stage: sales-qualified` in our flow.

sam: good call. I'll add a note in the publish checklist to confirm HubSpot flows: `if company_size > 500 -> tag:enterprise_lead`

jordan: editorial nit: the opening paragraph still reads a bit dense. Try this shorter opener: "Today we’re launching a runtime that makes production LLM inference predictable and cost-effective — designed for teams running inference at scale."

emma: swapping that in now.

rachel: approvals needed: legal completed (pending final doc link), product (sam/jordan) approve copy, demand (li) approve HS mapping. If all green by EOD we can queue for Wed publish.

jordan: approve from product side after the chart caption tweak.

sam: approve. small ask: include a one-sentence note on rollout options (hosted/dedicated/private) near the end.

emma: added rollout sentence.

li: approve from demand. Confirmed HS form `ri_product_launch_v1` will be used and flows set.

rachel: legal final: added a short attribution clause and the benchmark caveat. approve.

emma: thanks everyone — scheduling the publish and webinar email draft now. Leaving the doc in comments mode for any micro-edits. :rocket: 

ops-bot: calendar event created: "Product Post + Webinar Promotion" Wed 10:00 PDT. Invitees: marketing, demand, product."
